title: Every seeded Northwind product is impossible to purchase (checkout returns INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT with available=0 although 145 units are in stock)
preconditions: Fresh `pnpm seed` data. Northwind storefront, any seeded product, COD, qty 1.
steps: GET /storefront/products on host northwind.ems.localhost; pick any product (all 12 are type SIMPLE).
POST /storefront/checkout/orders with Idempotency-Key, COD, valid address.
expected: 201 with an order number; stock reserved.
actual: 409 INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT {"requested":1,"available":0}. 12/12 products fail, qty 1 and 3. Merchant-created products (console create + inventory adjust) order fine (WF-001..012 PASS).
evidence: qa/api/05-storefront-workflow SF-017; DB: `inventory_levels.variant_id` = 1..12 for all seeded rows while the products are SIMPLE with no variants (storefront returns `variants: []`) and the order line sends `variantId: null`; `InventoryRepository.findSlot` filters `variant_id IS NULL` so no slot is found.
root_cause: `apps/api/src/database/seeds/seed-northwind-rich-data.ts` (~lines 390-425) creates a default ProductVariant per SIMPLE product and attaches the stock to `variantId: savedVariant.id`, but SIMPLE products are sold with `variantId = null`. Seed/data-model mismatch (not reproduced on merchant-created products).
fix: Seed inventory for SIMPLE products with `variantId: null` (and do not create a default variant), or make cart/checkout resolve the sole default variant for SIMPLE products. Add a seed self-check that every ACTIVE product has a purchasable slot.
regression: DB-012 + SF-017 (seeded product can be ordered end to end). Add a seed smoke test to CI.

title: No HTTP rate limiting exists: unauthenticated gift-card lookups and failed logins for unknown accounts are unthrottled
steps: Send 40 rapid POST /storefront/gift-cards/check-balance with different codes.
Send 12 wrong-password POST /auth/login for one non-existent email.
expected: HTTP 429 (Retry-After) after a small burst; gift-card code enumeration is throttled.
actual: All 40 return 201 (a `valid:true` + balance oracle for real codes, e.g. NW-GIFT-5000 -> ₹5,000.00); all 12 logins return 401, never 429/423.
evidence: qa/api/07 SEC-012/013. Code review: `RATE_LIMIT_*` env vars are parsed but never consumed; `@nestjs/throttler` is a dependency that is never imported; only nginx (not active locally) rate limits. Account lockout (5 failures / 15 min) exists for real accounts (read in auth.service.ts; deliberately not exercised against shared demo accounts).
root_cause: Throttling was configured but never wired (also listed as an open P0 in PRODUCTION_READINESS_REPORT.md).
fix: Add a Redis-backed throttler guard (IP + tenant + route class), strict on auth/*, storefront/auth/*, gift-cards/check-balance, reviews, checkout.
regression: SEC-012, SEC-013 must pass; add per-endpoint limits tests.

title: Merchant Orders page crashes with "Rendered more hooks than during the previous render" on direct load (reproduced 4 of 6 loads)
preconditions: Logged in as owner@northwind.test; hard-load /orders (not client navigation).
steps: Navigate directly to /orders (page.goto) and wait 3 s; repeat.
actual: "Application error: a client-side exception has occurred" in 4/6 loads; pageerror `Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.`
evidence: qa-reports/console-company-routes.json; probe run 4/6. `apps/console/src/app/(app)/orders/page.tsx` lines 85-86 call `useState` after an early `return` (`if (!store) return ...`) — also reported by `next lint` (react-hooks/rules-of-hooks).
root_cause: Conditional hooks: `useState` for isExporting/selectedOrderIds declared after the `if (!store)` early return; when `store` resolves between renders the hook count changes.
fix: Move both `useState` calls above every early return (same fix pattern already applied to storefront MobileNav in commit 0da8c89).
regression: CON-010 (/orders), plus enable the `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` lint as a CI gate.

title: Merchant Subscription page crashes (client-side exception) when the tenant has no subscription
preconditions: Tenant without a subscription row (both seeded demo tenants).
expected: Empty state ("no active plan" with a plan chooser).
actual: "Application error: a client-side exception has occurred"; page errors `Rendered more hooks than during the previous render` and `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replace')`. Deterministic.
evidence: qa-reports/console-company-routes.json, probe screenshot. API 404 is returned for a missing subscription.
root_cause: Unhandled 404/undefined subscription state plus conditional hooks in the subscription page (suspected: apps/console/src/app/(app)/subscription/page.tsx).
fix: Treat 404 as 'no subscription', hoist hooks, guard `.replace` on undefined plan/status strings.
regression: CON-010 (/subscription) with a tenant that has no subscription.

title: Unknown `x-ems-hostname` resolves to the first active tenant (Northwind) instead of 404 when the API is reached via a dev host
route: GET /api/v1/storefront/store and /storefront/products with header x-ems-hostname: qa-unknown-tenant.ems.localhost (Host: localhost)
expected: 404/400 TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING (same as a raw unknown Host header, which is correctly rejected: TEN-011a PASS).
actual: 200 with Northwind Traders store and catalogue; `Host: localhost` alone also resolves to Northwind.
evidence: qa/api/03 TEN-011b FAIL; probe output. Code: `tenant-resolver.middleware.ts` Fallback 2 (lines ~172-187) is not gated by NODE_ENV and runs when the *Host* is a dev host even if the forwarded hostname is unknown.
root_cause: Dev-convenience fallback 'first ACTIVE tenant' is reachable in any environment and also triggers for unknown forwarded hostnames.
fix: Gate Fallback 2 behind NODE_ENV!=='production' and only when no forwarded hostname was supplied; return 404 for an unknown forwarded hostname.

title: GET /metrics returns HTTP 500 ("Value is not a valid number: 182") so Prometheus scraping is broken
actual: 500 INTERNAL_ERROR; context.detail: 'Value is not a valid number: 182' (a gauge is being set with a string).
root_cause: A prom-client gauge/counter receives a numeric string (MySQL COUNT returned as string) instead of a number (suspected in the DB/queue gauge collectors).
fix: Coerce with Number() before .set()/.inc(); add an e2e test hitting /metrics.

title: Storefront product detail page logs a React hydration mismatch error on every load
steps: Open any product detail page with a fresh browser context; read the console.
actual: pageerror 'Hydration failed because the server rendered HTML didn't match the client' (React regenerates the tree client-side; can cause flicker/lost state).
evidence: qa/e2e/03 STO-003 FAIL (reproduced twice); dev-mode stack not narrowed to a component.
root_cause: Suspected: client-only value (Date/locale formatting or window check) or invalid HTML nesting in the product detail tree.
fix: Reproduce with `next build && next start`, bisect the detail components, gate client-only values behind useEffect.

title: Request body above the size limit returns 500 INTERNAL_ERROR instead of 413
route: POST /api/v1/auth/login with a ~5 MB JSON body
expected: 413 Payload Too Large (or 400/422) in the standard envelope.
actual: 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (`context.detail: request entity too large`) with correlationId 'unknown'.
root_cause: GlobalExceptionFilter does not map body-parser's PayloadTooLargeError (status 413) and treats it as unexpected; error occurs before the correlation middleware.
fix: Map `err.status/ type==='entity.too.large'` to 413 in the filter.

title: Client-facing error leaks internal class names ("Operation 'StoreEntity query' requires a tenant context")
route: GET /api/v1/storefront/store with an unknown Host header
expected: Generic message without ORM entity names.
actual: 400 TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING with the entity name and a `context` object.
root_cause: Error message built from the guarded repository operation.
fix: Use a generic public message; log details server-side.

title: /plans page has no <h1> (section heading is an <h2>)
expected: Exactly one <h1> per page (every other marketing page has one).
actual: No <h1> (fails at desktop, tablet and mobile; reproduced on retry).
fix: Render PageHero (or promote the section heading to h1) on the dedicated /plans route.

title: All six marketing pages share the same <meta name=description>
steps: Read the meta description on each route.
actual: One identical description everywhere (1 distinct value across 6 pages).
root_cause: Only the root layout defines `metadata.description`; sub-pages only set `title`.
fix: Add `description` to each page's `metadata` (ideally from the website content).

title: Every super-admin page triggers a tenant-only API call that is always 403 (`GET /console/inventory/low-stock`)
steps: Open any /analytics, /tenants, ... page and watch network.
expected: Platform shell does not call company endpoints.
actual: 403 on every page; on the landing page also 403 for /console/stores and /console/customers. Noise in logs/audit, wasted requests.
root_cause: Shared layout widget fetches low-stock regardless of user type.
regression: Extend CON-005 to fail on unexpected 4xx.

title: GET /storefront/theme returns 404 'Published theme for this store not found' for the seeded Northwind store
actual: 404 (theme-assignment endpoint returns `organic` correctly; the storefront renders, so a UI fallback exists).
root_cause: No published `tenant_themes` row for the seeded tenant; not confirmed to be user-visible.
fix: Seed a published theme row or return the assigned theme.
